title: The Long Terminal
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
